tolerance.notes: Conservative overlap regridder (RFC pure-io-data-loaders §8 + CONFORMANCE_SPEC §5.8). The PRIMARY cross-binding gate is the two PHYSICAL INVARIANTS — global conservation (Σ_j A_j·F_tgt = Σ_i A_i·F_src) and partition-of-unity (Σ_i W_ij = 1) — which are exact BY CONSTRUCTION (both sides from the same engine-computed overlap areas) and therefore binding-independent. Per §5.8 the per-pair overlap areas A_ij are floating-point polygon-clip results (GeometryOps/Julia, S2/Python+Rust) and are tolerance-based, NOT byte-identical; the golden A_j/F_tgt are the reference-binding (Julia/GeometryOps) values, compared only to area_relative. The integer bin-Skolem candidate set is byte-identical per §5.5 (verified by the co-located kernel test).

narrow_phase_rep.note: 1-based src 2 ∩ tgt 1 = lon[1,1.5]×lat[0,1], the fractional representative overlap

notes: 3 source + 3 target axis-aligned spherical cells (CCW lon/lat rings, degrees) in a thin equatorial band lat∈[0,1]°; the target grid refines the source within each lon-bin. With dx=dy=2 the bins are (floor(rep_lon/2),floor(rep_lat/2)): src/tgt cells 1,2 in lon-bin 0, cell 3 in lon-bin 1 — so the broad phase is load-bearing.
